messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف معلومات غير موجودة، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON فقط وفق الشكل: {"book_code":"TADAM","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"text_ar":"..."}]}. أخرج وحدة واحدة لكل مدخل بالترتيب. إذا كان مرجع المصدر مجمّعاً مثل 1,2 فترجم نصه مرة واحدة واجعل verse أول رقم فقط، ولا تقسّمه إلى وحدتين.

{"book_code":"TADAM","units":[{"chapter":9,"source_ref":"9:4","text":"and he hath sent me to bring you out of the water and give you the nourishment which you had in paradise, and for which you are crying"},{"chapter":9,"source_ref":"9:5","text":"out. Now come out of the water and I will conduct you to the place where your victual hath been made ready.'"},{"chapter":10,"source_ref":"10:1","text":"But Eve heard and believed and went out of the water of the river, and her flesh was (trembling)"},{"chapter":10,"source_ref":"10:2","text":"like grass, from the chill of the water. And when she had gone out, she fell on the earth and the devil raised her up and led her to Adam."},{"chapter":10,"source_ref":"10:3","text":"But when Adam had seen her and the devil with her, he wept and cried aloud and said: 'O Eve, Eve, where is the labour of thy penitence"}]}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return one item per input unit, in input order, using the first printed number when a source label is grouped: 9:4, 9:5, 10:1, 10:2, 10:3.
